reproduction.rails_runner:
require "json"
require "digest"
raise "test only" unless Rails.env.test?
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "mysql2", socket: "/var/lib/mysql/mysql.sock", username: "root", password: ENV.fetch("MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD"), database: "hrm_test", encoding: "utf8mb4")
c = ActiveRecord::Base.connection
raise "wrong DB" unless c.select_value("SELECT DATABASE()") == "hrm_test"
raise "must be empty disposable database" unless c.tables.empty?
ActiveRecord::Migration.verbose = false
load "/proof/old_schema.rb"
context = ActiveRecord::MigrationContext.new(Rails.application.paths["db/migrate"].to_a)
old_versions = %w[20261025000001 20261028000001 20261028000002]
raise "historical version mismatch" unless context.get_all_versions.map(&:to_s).sort == old_versions.sort
raw = ->(table, attrs) do
  now = Time.current
  values = attrs.merge(created_at: now, updated_at: now).slice(*c.columns(table).map { |col| col.name.to_sym })
  c.execute("INSERT INTO #{c.quote_table_name(table)} (#{values.keys.map { |k| c.quote_column_name(k) }.join(',')}) VALUES (#{values.values.map { |v| c.quote(v) }.join(',')})")
  c.select_value("SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()").to_i
end
ids = ["A", "B"].each_with_index.map do |suffix, n|
  company = raw.call("companies", code: "UPGRADE_#{suffix}", name: "Upgrade sample #{suffix}")
  role_id = raw.call("company_roles", company_id: company, key: "admin", name: "Sample admin")
  %w[payroll.read payroll.create payroll.finalize].each do |key|
    permission_id = c.select_value("SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE `key`=#{c.quote(key)}") || raw.call("permissions", key: key, name: "Sample permission")
    raw.call("role_permissions", company_role_id: role_id, permission_id: permission_id)
  end
  user = raw.call("users", company_id: company, role: "admin", email: "upgrade-#{suffix.downcase}@example.test", password_digest: BCrypt::Password.create(SecureRandom.hex(24)))
  raw.call("api_tokens", user_id: user, digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(SecureRandom.hex(32)), expires_at: Time.current + 3600)
  department = raw.call("departments", company_id: company, code: "QA", name: "Sample")
  employee = raw.call("employees", company_id: company, department_id: department, user_id: user, employee_code: "OLD_#{suffix}", full_name: "Historical #{suffix}", email: "employee-#{suffix.downcase}@example.test", job_title: "Sample", hired_on: Date.new(2026, 1, 1), salary_cents: (n+2)*10000000)
  run = raw.call("pay_runs", company_id: company, created_by_id: user, period: Date.new(2026, 1, 1), status: "finalized", finalized_at: Time.current)
  slip = raw.call("payslips", company_id: company, pay_run_id: run, employee_id: employee, gross_cents: (n+2)*10000000, deductions_cents: 0, net_cents: (n+2)*10000000)
  [company, user, employee, run, slip]
end
snapshot = lambda do
  %w[companies users api_tokens employees pay_runs payslips].to_h do |table|
    columns = c.columns(table).map(&:name)
    [table, c.exec_query("SELECT #{columns.map { |col| c.quote_column_name(col) }.join(',')} FROM #{c.quote_table_name(table)} ORDER BY id").to_a]
  end
end
before = snapshot.call
puts JSON.generate(stage: "before", mysql: c.select_value("SELECT VERSION()"), migrations: context.get_all_versions, companies: ids.size, payslips: ids.size, constraints: c.exec_query("SELECT CONSTRAINT_TYPE,COUNT(*) AS total FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() GROUP BY CONSTRAINT_TYPE ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_TYPE").to_a, indexes: c.select_value("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()").to_i, schema_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file('/proof/old_schema.rb').hexdigest)
context.migrate
ApplicationRecord.descendants.each(&:reset_column_information)
# Verify every original column value; newly nullable historical identity must stay unknown.
after = snapshot.call
before.each do |table, rows|
  raise "legacy data changed in #{table}" unless rows == after.fetch(table).map { |row| row.slice(*rows.first.keys) }
end
raise "pending migrations" if context.needs_migration?
raise "credential principal backfill failed" unless c.select_value("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM api_tokens WHERE principal_user_id = user_id").to_i == 2
Rails.application.eager_load!
ActiveJob::Base.queue_adapter = :test
results = ids.map do |company_id, user_id, employee_id, run_id, slip_id|
  actor = User.find(user_id)
  employee = Employee.find(employee_id)
  old = Payslip.find(slip_id)
  raise "legacy identity fabricated" unless old.employee_code_snapshot.nil? && old.employee_name_snapshot.nil?
  listed = HrmPayroll::Application::Queries::ListPayslips.new.call(run: PayRun.find(run_id), actor: actor)
  raise "legacy slip unreadable" unless listed.map(&:id).include?(slip_id)
  # New CSV grants must come from the actual migration, not harness provisioning.
  begin
    HrmPayroll::Application::Commands::CreateExport.new.call(actor: actor, pay_run_id: run_id)
    raise "must reject fabricated legacy export"
  rescue HrmPayroll::Domain::Services::PayrollCsv::InvalidSource
    # No historical identity snapshot exists; never substitute live employee data.
  end
  run = HrmPayroll::Application::Commands::BuildPayRun.new.call(actor: actor, period: Date.new(2026, 2, 1))
  captured = run.payslips.first
  employee.update!(full_name: "Changed after snapshot", salary_cents: 99000000)
  run = HrmPayroll::Application::Commands::FinalizePayRun.new.call(actor: actor, run: run)
  export = HrmPayroll::Application::Commands::CreateExport.new.call(actor: actor, pay_run_id: run.id)
  download = HrmPayroll::Application::Commands::DownloadExport.new.call(actor: actor, id: export.id)
  raise "snapshot changed" unless captured.reload.gross_cents == old.gross_cents && captured.employee_code_snapshot == employee.employee_code
  raise "empty CSV" unless download.fetch(:bytes).include?(employee.employee_code)
  other = ids.find { |row| row[0] != company_id }
  begin
    HrmPayroll::Application::Queries::ListPayslips.new.call(run: PayRun.find(other[3]), actor: actor)
    raise "cross company allowed"
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, Pundit::NotAuthorizedError
  end
  {company: company_id, legacy_net: old.net_cents, legacy_identity: nil, legacy_export: "rejected_missing_snapshot", new_status: run.status, new_snapshot: captured.gross_cents, csv_bytes: download.fetch(:bytes).bytesize, cross_company: "denied"}
end
puts JSON.generate(stage: "after", migrations: context.get_all_versions, results: results)
# Definition comparison with a fresh structure.sql is performed by the host afterwards.
require "open3"
c.execute("CREATE DATABASE hrm_fresh CHARACTER SET utf8mb4")
output, error, status = Open3.capture3({ "MYSQL_PWD" => ENV.fetch("MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD") }, "mysql", "--socket=/var/lib/mysql/mysql.sock", "--user=root", "hrm_fresh", stdin_data: File.read(Rails.root.join("db/structure.sql")))
raise "fresh SQL load failed: #{error}" unless status.success?
metadata = lambda do |db|
  {
    columns: c.exec_query("SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_DEFAULT FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='#{db}' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION").to_a,
    indexes: c.exec_query("SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,SUB_PART FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='#{db}' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX").to_a,
    key_column_usage: c.exec_query("SELECT TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='#{db}' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION").to_a,
    checks: c.exec_query("SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME,CHECK_CLAUSE FROM information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='#{db}' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NAME").to_a,
    triggers: c.exec_query("SELECT TRIGGER_NAME,ACTION_TIMING,EVENT_MANIPULATION,ACTION_STATEMENT FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA='#{db}' ORDER BY TRIGGER_NAME").to_a,
    constraints: c.exec_query("SELECT CONSTRAINT_TYPE,COUNT(*) AS total FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='#{db}' GROUP BY CONSTRAINT_TYPE ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_TYPE").to_a,
    versions: c.select_values("SELECT version FROM #{db}.schema_migrations ORDER BY version")
  }
end
actual, expected = metadata.call('hrm_test'), metadata.call('hrm_fresh')
# Migration uses squished SQL; structure.sql stores formatted trigger bodies.
# Normalize only whitespace outside quoted literals/identifiers, preserving messages.
[actual, expected].each do |definition|
  definition[:triggers].each do |trigger|
    trigger["ACTION_STATEMENT"] = trigger.fetch("ACTION_STATEMENT").split(/('(?:''|[^'])*'|`(?:``|[^`])*`)/).each_with_index.map { |part, i| i.odd? ? part : part.gsub(/\s+/, " ") }.join.strip
  end
end
different = actual.keys.reject { |key| actual[key] == expected[key] }
if different.any?
  puts JSON.generate(stage: "metadata_difference", keys: different, counts: actual.transform_values(&:size), expected_counts: expected.transform_values(&:size))
  different.each { |k| puts JSON.generate(kind: k, only_upgrade: actual[k]-expected[k], only_fresh: expected[k]-actual[k]) }
  raise "Upgraded schema differs from fresh SQL"
end
reject = lambda do |sql, code|
  begin
    c.execute(sql)
  rescue ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid => e
    raise unless e.cause.respond_to?(:error_number) && e.cause.error_number == code
    next
  end
  raise "Constraint did not reject sample write"
end
reject.call("UPDATE employees SET salary_cents=-1 WHERE id=#{ids[0][2]}", 3819)
reject.call("UPDATE payslips SET employee_id=#{ids[1][2]} WHERE id=#{ids[0][4]}", 1452)
reject.call("UPDATE users SET principal_user_id=id WHERE id=#{ids[0][1]}", 1644)
reject.call("UPDATE companies SET code='UPGRADE_A' WHERE id=#{ids[1][0]}", 1062)
puts JSON.generate(stage: "schema_verified", counts: actual.transform_values(&:size), definition_sha256: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(JSON.generate(actual)), constraint_rejections: ["CHECK", "composite_FK", "membership_trigger", "unique_index"])

limits: Initial harness attempts fixed temporary-server readiness, automatic schema versions and fixture columns/grants; no product suppression added
Reproduction is pinned to recorded immutable application and MySQL image IDs; these images must remain available locally.
